keep_playing_why: B had something happening every few seconds: chains, a charged BLOOM, ink turning to colour under my feet, a lens choice after the first inkwell, and a visible goal that moved (4 inkwells left). A gave me one windmill out of three in nine minutes, most of it walking and fighting the camera, and its prompts always named the target. Neither had deep systems, but B at least made me change how I moved (stay on painted ground) and A never did.
better_made_why: B is cohesive on a phone: clean landscape layout, readable HUD, strong ink-to-colour art shift, dense layered kill audio and a music bed. A is also lovely to look at with a good ambient bed, but the camera clipped into walls and hid the character, the assist hung twice and needed a restart, and payoffs were sparse. B had a few camera clips through house walls and a long respawn walk.
